answers.reason: The president leads the university and chairs its central bodies, of which the senate is the primary one deciding overall strategy and structure.
The budget is the specific domain of the chancellor, and every member only takes part in the one place where their specific matters are decided.
The president only participates in their designated central body and does not sit in committees dealing with other delimited questions like appointments.
The faculty council is chaired by the dean to decide faculty affairs, and higher officials do not sit in bodies dealing with other kinds of questions.
The president does not sit in bodies that deal with teaching and degree programme questions, even though they hold a higher office.
Examination matters are strictly separate from central university leadership, and the president only participates in their single designated body.
This round handles faculty-level research grants, which is outside the single central body where the president takes part.
Rewriting module descriptions is a specialized teaching matter, and the president does not sit in bodies outside their own central remit.
Choosing laboratory equipment is a separate matter outside the president's single place of participation.
Planning the orientation week for new students is outside the central strategy body to which the president's participation is restricted.
